page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, requiring external block storage for persistent data.

Benchmark data places this server in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1436.68, while the multi-core score reaches 30666.35. In memory bandwidth testing, the instance achieves 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Cryptographic and compression capabilities are supported by AVX-512 and AES instruction sets, yielding a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 25.02 GB/sec and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 140.98 GB/sec. For database operations, the server processes 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 11442.59 in Passmark database tests.

The qualitative cost efficiency of the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is defined by its dedicated compute resources and balanced memory allocation, making it suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU accelerators limits its utility for high-speed local caching or heavy deep learning tasks. It is best suited for general-purpose workloads, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
